scope: Finite future-work-claim lease configuration from IQS preparation/frozen bundle through StockQA CLI/runner/lifecycle, with original default and expired-lease fences preserved. Engineering-only acceptance.

coverage: Explicit value changes both original preparation binding and whole-bundle fingerprint, reaches one command flag; legacy argv remains exactly unchanged.

NaN and infinity produce typed UI/config errors before bundle hashing or native interfaces, and are rejected by the shared SDK guard.

source_review: IQS service allowlists and validates prepare/bundle duration, PrepareGateway validates before original preparation, and ExecutionGateway validates before fingerprint/launch. Booleans, non-finite, non-integer UI values and out-of-range values are rejected.

Preparation binding includes all relevant options, including lease, and new scope execution bundle freezes the explicit field. Execution fingerprint includes the entire registration; changing a bundle lease cannot silently resume an older run fingerprint.
Only explicit registered bundle values append --work-lease-seconds. Missing values preserve old argv and StockQA600.0 default.

StockQA validates public CLI arguments before constructing the runner; runner and private single-company path and lifecycle constructor share one bounded numeric guard. Only non-default values are forwarded, preserving legacy mocks and default argument shapes.

Non-default runner value requires one identity-bound search company and rejects unsupported batch/seal paths rather than silently ignoring it. Actual lifecycle receives the parameter for ordinary and registered question-pack claim paths.

All old store claim/save/known-outcome/settlement/owner-permission mechanisms are unchanged. No renew, clock extension, loosened CP acceptance, unknown resend or new financial permission is introduced.

README and product contract distinguish delegation lifetime, future claim lease, preparation worker/native timeouts and HTTP read timeout. They explicitly state new-only control and no old lease/grant extension.
Unrelated import line wrapping in runner is formatting-only; no additional recovery/journal/fee logic changed.
